bodyConversion: Native 64 spherical axis-angle converted through C8 and the reference rig into Xiaoyu's extracted bind orientations; target's original body scaling and skin weights retained.
sharedClips: Only reuse common-bank body clips with identical source SHA256 and verified compatible body bind orientations.
skinInfluences: Four strongest original normalized influences per vertex; helper/finger/face influences are preserved.
stagingSecondary: Native 19-channel hand tracks on all nine takes; native 90-channel facial tracks on eight takes.
stagingCameras: Eight original camera resources; optional museum playback uses the existing frontal framing adaptation.

secondaryPhysics.implementation: Adapted Unity cloth plus damped bone springs; not the original Unreal solver.
secondaryPhysics.scope: All four imported costumes: hair chains, feathers, tassels and garment hems; body, face and hands retain their animation bindings.
secondaryPhysics.cloth: Pinned attachment areas, bounded hem motion, torso/thigh/calf capsule collisions, bending stiffness 0.75 and damping 0.5.
secondaryPhysics.seeking: Reset bone-spring history and clear transform-induced cloth inertia on timeline jumps; retain simulation through continuous loops.
secondaryPhysics.rigRepair: Anonymous transformN helpers are scoped to each mesh piece so hair and clothing cannot accidentally share unrelated parents.

fallbacks: fu_w01_y has no independent source camera/face event; uses museum orbit camera and bind face.
Combat clips currently apply body channels; action-specific combat finger/facial tracks are not integrated.
Palette/normal/roughness/specular/AO maps are adapted to HDRP; renderer appearance is not an exact original-engine reproduction.
Additional source channels for attachments are retained in extracted native clips but are not played by the 19-bone body sampler.
